recognize_zh: 兩個比旁邊嗜中性球大好幾倍的巨大原紅血球，細胞質深藍，巨大圓核內為淡粉紫色、細顆粒毛玻璃樣的病毒包涵體，染色質沿核膜濃縮成一圈，形成燈籠細胞外觀，符合 Parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Two giant pronormoblasts several times the size of adjacent neutrophils (scale bar 10 µm)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, slightly frayed borders
Very large nucleus with pale pink-lilac, finely granular glassy inclusion and marginated chromatin
Nucleolus-like pale areas within the inclusion
Background mature neutrophils, band forms, a myelocyte and erythrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and enormous round nuclei in which the chromatin is replaced by a pale, glassy, finely granular intranuclear inclusion with a thin rim of condensed chromatin. Adjacent mature neutrophils and granulocytic precursors are unremarkable. These cells are characteristic lantern cells of parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with reticulocytopenia and viral PCR or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: PEL blasts occur in sheets and lack the glassy intranuclear inclusions with chromatin margination seen in scattered parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts.
Megaloblastic precursors show open sieve-like chromatin and a full maturation spectrum of megaloblasts, rather than an inclusion-filled nucleus with erythroid maturation arrest.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like or other large atypical tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells have prominent eosinophilic macronucleoli and are erythroid-marker negative, not deeply basophilic cells with a glassy viral nuclear inclusion.
